title: Today's Last Straw

hook.en: Drop your own face between three familiar workplace disasters.
hook.zh: 把自己的头像投入三种熟悉的职场灾难，看今天哪一种会落到你头上。

control.commitment: Tap once to release the current player's avatar into the Plinko field.

identityEntry: The current player's avatar is the physical Plinko puck that receives the result.

results.label: THE BOSS
results.emotionalRisk: A boss publicly packs the protagonist's desk into a cardboard box.
results.turn: The company owner arrives and makes the abusive boss pack his own box instead.
beats: The boss drops the protagonist's belongings into a box.
Coworkers watch the public firing without intervening.
The company owner enters and identifies the actual problem.
The boss leaves carrying his own box while the protagonist stays.

results.label: REPLY ALL
results.emotionalRisk: An accidental all-company message appears to expose the protagonist publicly.
results.turn: Coworkers recognize stolen work in the message and stand with the protagonist.
beats: Office phones light up with the accidental message.
Coworkers read while the protagonist expects humiliation.
The group recognizes evidence that her work was stolen.
Coworkers gather beside her instead of laughing.

results.label: THE SPILL
results.emotionalRisk: The protagonist is blamed for spilling an entitled coworker's coffee.
results.turn: The accuser steps onto his own spill and safely slides to the floor.
beats: Coffee spills and the coworker immediately blames the protagonist.
He continues accusing her while standing beside the wet patch.
He steps backward onto the spill he caused.
He safely slides into a seated position as the accusation collapses.
